{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to avoid overestimating price spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast bias by averaging the last 5-7 days of true prices before a forecast horizon to correct for mean reversion.",
    "If model shows significant overshoot after a price spike (forecast > true outcome by >10%), apply a 5-10% downward correction.",
    "For long-term forecasts (e.g., 30-day), reduce volatility by smoothing with a 3-day moving average if sentiment is flat.",
    "When sentiment increases (e.g., >0.25), slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 15% above recent high.",
    "Correct for lagged forecasts by aligning with the most recent 3-day true price trend, especially if forecast is 2-3 days behind the actual trend.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility — if true outcome deviates >15% from forecast, re-evaluate model’s sensitivity to sentiment shifts."
  ]
}
